interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge and Crosswalk

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with high-visibility patterns to provide designated crossing points for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Speed humps

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation and Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the number and width of driveways to minimize conflict points and slow down turning vehicles entering and exiting commercial lots.

interventions.title: New Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Construct a continuous paved sidewalk on the near side of the street to complete the pedestrian network.

interventions.title: Continuous Buffered Sidewalks
interventions.description: Construct a continuous sidewalk on the right side with a planting strip or buffer to separate pedestrians from the roadway and parking lots.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Install street trees or large planters to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add street lighting to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians during evening hours.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-block Crosswalk

interventions.title: Speed Humps or Cushions
interventions.description: Implement vertical traffic calming measures to reduce vehicle speeds in this residential environment.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalk with Refuge Island

interventions.title: Daylighting

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing or Road Diet

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Curb Ramps

interventions.title: Midblock Crossing with RRFB

interventions.title: Traffic Calming

interventions.title: Mid-Block Crossing with Refuge Island
